conf.description: Citrix ADC (NetScaler) tcp-http-access / json (NSOE AppFlow http_event): custom reparse - no stock Elastic integration covers the NSOE/observability JSON (citrix_adc integration is syslog-only). JSON-parses the http_event document, splits httpReqUrl into url.path/url.query, coerces clientConnStartTimestamp (rendered as a string on newer NSOE builds) to epoch seconds, then renames the rest to ECS/custom.

conf.comment: citrix-adc / tcp-http-access / json. NSOE's http_event JSON mirrors the IPFIX enterprise IE inventory with netscaler* dropped; no stock integration parses it, so this is a hand-built reparse. Per recommendations.direct.cribl, direct has no boundary, so httpReqUrl/httpReqUserAgent are kept at FULL length - the capping instruction lives only in the guarded recommendation. clientConnStartTimestamp needs coercion since newer NSOE builds render it as a string; this pipeline also tolerates a numeric epoch in seconds/ms/microseconds by magnitude. The user_agent processor Elastic calls for runs downstream, not here (no such Cribl function) - user_agent.original is populated verbatim for it. Order: JSON parse -> eval (ORIGINAL names) -> rename.
